module_title: Introduction to NITI Aayog and Core Principles
introduction: At this beginner level, we will understand what NITI Aayog is, why it was created, and its foundational difference from the erstwhile Planning Commission.

core_concepts.title: Establishment and Full Form
core_concepts.description: NITI Aayog stands for 'National Institution for Transforming India'. It was established on 'January 1, 2015', via an executive resolution of the Union Cabinet, officially replacing the Planning Commission.

core_concepts.title: Nature of the Body
core_concepts.description: Just like the Planning Commission, NITI Aayog is an 'Extra-Constitutional' (no mention in the Constitution) and 'Non-Statutory' (not created by an Act of Parliament) body. It is the premier policy 'Think Tank' of the Government of India.

core_concepts.title: Cooperative Federalism
core_concepts.description: The Planning Commission used a 'Top-Down' approach (Center dictating to States). NITI Aayog operates on a 'Bottom-Up' approach based on 'Cooperative Federalism'—meaning the Central and State governments work together as equal partners in national development.

core_concepts.title: Competitive Federalism
core_concepts.description: NITI Aayog also promotes 'Competitive Federalism' by ranking states on various parameters (like health, water management, and export preparedness) to encourage healthy competition among them to improve governance.

important_entities.name: Think Tank
important_entities.significance: Unlike the Planning Commission, which had administrative and financial powers, NITI Aayog is strictly an advisory 'Think Tank'. It provides strategic and technical advice to the Central and State Governments on key policy matters.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: This is the most frequently asked question in UPSC/PCS. 'Which of the following bodies allocates funds to states?' If NITI Aayog is an option, DO NOT select it. NITI Aayog has ZERO financial powers to allocate funds. That power was transferred entirely to the 'Ministry of Finance'.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: NITI Aayog was established exactly on New Year's Day: January 1, 2015.

exam_strategy_tips: Always remember the full expansion of NITI. Examiners often replace 'Institution' with 'Institute' in the options to confuse students. It is strictly 'National Institution for Transforming India'.
